project.name: ForwardMeasure Data Streaming Test Fixtures
project.description: Shared, real (never fictional/simplified) source-data and IngestionSpec fixtures for integration tests that need them - WorldCheck today, State Street following the identical pattern. A real `main`-scope dependency (not a test-jar), deliberately: Phase G/H's 18/36-cell integration-test matrix needs the exact same fixture reachable from three separate framework- binding test suites (Quarkus/Spring/Micronaut), so it has to be a real compile-time dependency each of those can add, not something copy-pasted three times or reachable only from one module's own test classpath. Each real fixture (e.g. WorldCheckFixtures) mirrors the shape already proven in forwardmeasure-data-streaming-executor-pekko's own PekkoWorldCheckToOpenSearchIntegrationTest - copied, not reinvented, from the org's own real entity-intelligence-specifications mapping/schema, byte-for-byte faithful column names.
